description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thelissagala, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District - Cad. Map No. 330307 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for various parcels in different villages. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
